name: postgres_run_sql
description: Run any SQL query against a PostgreSQL database. Works with Neon, Supabase, and any Postgres.

name: postgres_run_transaction
description: Run multiple SQL statements as a single atomic transaction with BEGIN/COMMIT

name: postgres_list_tables
description: List all tables in the database with their sizes

name: postgres_describe_table
description: Get column names, types, and constraints for a specific database table

name: postgres_list_indexes
description: List all indexes in the database

name: postgres_list_functions
description: List all stored functions and procedures in the database

name: postgres_get_table_row_count
description: Get approximate row counts for all tables

name: postgres_list_slow_queries
description: List the slowest queries using pg_stat_statements. Requires pg_stat_statements extension.

name: postgres_explain_query
description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a SQL query to see the query plan and execution time

name: postgres_get_active_connections
description: List all active database connections and their current queries

name: postgres_kill_query
description: Terminate a specific database query by its process ID (PID)

name: postgres_get_database_size
description: Get the total size of the database and the current Postgres version
